```yaml
name: Trigger Flaky Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, develop]
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node and install dependencies
        uses: MetaMask/action-checkout-and-setup@v3
        with:
          is-high-risk-environment: true
          fetch-depth: 0
          node-version: 22
          yarn-install-max-retries: 3
          skip-allow-scripts: false

      - name: Run lint
        run: yarn lint

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: yarn test:unit

      - name: Run e2e tests
        run: yarn test:e2e

      - name: Upload test results
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: test-results/
```
